question: Name the IMF report that analyzes the impact of artificial intelligence on electricity demand, prices, and carbon emissions.

options.text: The AI Transition and Global Labor Markets
Green Tech and the Global Energy Shift
Power Hungry: How AI Will Drive Energy Demand
Digital Futures: AI and Sustainable Growth

solution:
The correct answer is __**Power Hungry: How AI Will Drive Energy Demand.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The IMF released the report titled "Power Hungry: How AI Will Drive Energy Demand" on April 22, 2025, examining the effects of AI on global electricity usage and emissions.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **AI sectors in the U.S. grew nearly three times faster than other private non-farm sectors.**
 
• Electricity costs for integrated AI firms nearly doubled between 2019–2023.
 
• Electricity prices in the U.S. could increase by 8.6% by 2030 under constrained green infrastructure growth.
 
• The report recommends policy alignment between AI growth and energy infrastructure to manage environmental impact.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **IMF-ENV Model**__

 __
 
• Multi-country Computable General Equilibrium model used in the study.
 
• Simulates impacts of AI on energy consumption and carbon emissions globally.
 
• Estimates global carbon emissions could rise by 1.2% by 2030 under current policy settings.
 
 
 
• **Challenges Identified**__
 
 
• Limited growth in renewable energy and transmission capacity could worsen electricity prices.
 
• Need for environmentally conscious energy planning amid AI-driven tech growth.
 
• Highlights increasing energy intensity of large AI models like ChatGPT.
